Requiring only the link feels right, but I’d expect the app to fill in the page’s title, short description, and little site icon automatically, while still letting me change the title or description before saving. Otherwise I’m doing too much manual work, and a bare address won’t be very recognizable later.

Comma-separated tags are acceptable, though I’d like suggestions from tags I’ve already used as I type. Newest-first is a good default.

One important saving case is missing: if I enter a link I’ve already saved, I don’t want a duplicate. Please take me to the existing bookmark so I can update its tags or note instead. The saved item should show its title, description, tags, and site icon clearly.
